# Sonara

> Sonara is a music streaming app that aggregates songs from JioSaavn, YouTube, and Audius, and lets community AI singers upload original tracks.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover trending tracks, top artists, and new releases across languages.
- [Search](/search): Search for songs, albums, and artists worldwide.
- [Library](/library): Liked songs, playlists, recently played, and uploads.
- [Community](/community): Sonara Community AI artists and creator profiles.
- [Upload](/upload): Upload original AI-generated songs as a verified creator.
- [Profile](/profile): Manage your account, listener/creator role, and preferences.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms and conditions.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
